evidence.finding: SPR declares DM02 chassis and DJI C gimbal; H723 and F407 projects corroborate distinct MCUs, not target MOD4v1 binding.
Four DM_J8009 torque-mode joints plus two 3508-format wheel drives, not an all-Damiao source chassis.
Classic CAN 1Mbps on three FDCAN instances; bus1 left wheel+IDs3/4, bus2 right wheel+IDs1/2, bus3 inter-board and cap from configured send path.
DM position bounds are +/-3.14 despite +/-12.5 comments; torque +/-54 and speed +/-45 are source constants, not discovered motor registers.
Joint zero offsets and right-side negations are source-robot calibrations; they are not MOD4v1 calibration.
Wheel feedback uses 268/17, active command adds /13.94; isolated (268/17) is C integer division 15, not 15.7647.
BMI088 QEKF/gravity compensation and 2-state velocity KF exist; fixed dt=0.001, acceleration R=1e12, no lever-arm correction found in audited estimator path.
QEKF yaw total adds integer revolution count directly to radians without 2*pi; main rate loop uses gyro rather than this total.
Self-spin is -13/-9/-5 rad/s counter-based schedule, not constant 4*pi spin/start/stop/reverse qualification.
Ground/fall/recovery/jump/climb modes and contact classifiers exist; no uniform per-state measured timeout/qualification is evidenced.
Liftoff KNN and windowed impact KNN are called. Trained sample/centroid headers intentionally excluded; source comments admit domain limitations.
1000Hz RTOS tick and vTaskDelay(1) plus 200us busy-wait/20ms init delays are scheduling intent, not measured 1ms deadline proof.
Motor-offline zero-torque sends in send_task fall through independent DBUS branch; later normal commands can overwrite the gate in the same iteration.
Power allocator writes Right_Leg.Tp in place of Wheel_Right.Tp and divides by MovePower+TurnPower without zero guard; predictor only models 3508 wheels.
Power high bytes shifted right; receive callback lacks bus/DLC/status checks and shared global TX header/buffer has concurrent task users.
Generated kinematics hardcode 0.21/0.25 geometry; IK uses different geometry and 0.5m max exceeds ~0.4591m reach; no finite/domain guards.
Active chassis MPC.c only initializes A/B matrices; upstream LinearMPC archive has generic templates and codegen notes, not a linked board-qualified solver in the chassis project.
Keil ARMCC5.06u7/H7 DFP4.0.0 project and scatter map exist; no current target build or deployable BIN evidence was generated.
Unitree A1 RS485 and WIT UART IMU files are present but absent from current chassis project file list; live entry uses CAN and BMI088.
CMSIS/DSP Apache2, ST HAL BSD3 fallback, FreeRTOS MIT-style, LinearMPC MIT; no root custom SPR project license identified in indexed roots.

limitations: No physical board/motor/protocol configuration observation; no target firmware build.
Source-only absence claims are bounded to indexed names, selected text and current Keil entries.
KNN learned tables/centroids intentionally not extracted, so classifier calibration/domain remains unaudited.
Upstream MPC templates/author deployment statement do not prove active chassis integration or realtime tails.
GB18030 source transcoded to UTF8 with unchanged line structure; raw and extracted SHA256 are both recorded.
